newsitem.title: USA: Intl Game, Barcrest to make gaming machines.
newsitem.headline: Intl Game, Barcrest to make gaming machines.

text.p: International Game Technology Inc and Barcrest Ltd, based in Lancashire, England, have agreed to produce specialty gambling machines based on International Game's "spinning reel" technology and Barcrest's bonus displays.
The Barcrest displays will be installed in machines made at International Game's plant in Reno. Marketing and sales will be the responsibility of IGT.
"This type of game has proven to be extremely successful throughout Europe," said Bob Bittman, Executive Vice President of Product Development for International Game.
IGT and Barcrest plan to introduce the first of these newly-developed gaming machine products in October.
